traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Connaraceae: leaves alternate; leaves compound; compound leaves pinnate; stipules absent; plants usually hermaphrodite, sometimes dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in panicles or in racemes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit follicle or nut; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5 to 10; carpels 1 to 8. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
